newsitem.title: THAILAND: Tanayong taps $80 mln loan facility.
newsitem.headline: Tanayong taps $80 mln loan facility.

text.p: Tanayong Plc said on Monday it would borrow $80 million through a transferable loan certificate facility to partly finance its Bangkok rail mass transit system.
Tanayong said in a brief filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand the loan would be arranged by Schroder International Merchant Bankers Ltd. It did not give any other details.

Tanayong's Bangkok Transit System Corp unit holds a 30-year concession to operate a 23.5-km elevated rail system that is due to start running through central Bangkok in 1998. The project will cost $1.68 billion to build.
